name: ChildStory 2: Say Cheese!
detailed_description:
Many years have passed when Sonya Ferris dreamed of adventures with a big cheese moon. Now she is an independent girl who has saved enough money to move out from her parents and open her own cheese factory in a magical town built by a wizard. Villagers say brick walls protect houses from monsters, but when Sonya doesn't know about it. She cooks cheese, earns money, but the girl can't leave her thoughts. What happens at night in the wizard's tower?
---

Features

Turn an old coffee shop into a thriving new cheese dairy! Gather ingredients to craft cheese, master the art of fermentation, and sell your delicious products! What more could you dream of?!

Meet and befriend the locals. In the northern town of Little Brick, dozens of colorful characters live with their own routines, festivals, and stories. As you interact with them, you’ll uncover their secrets, help them through tough times, and become part of their lives. Take part in vibrant seasonal events full of surprises!

Venture into the Master’s Tower, unravel its mystery, and restore peaceful sleep to the people of Little Brick Town! With each floor, the challenges grow harder—but the ingredients dropped by monsters become tastier!

Shape the town’s future! Conflicts will arise, and Sonya won’t be prepared. She’ll have to pick a side and change Zakirpichye in the way she sees fit.

Start a family. Among the townsfolk, there are 10 characters ready to share their life with you at the cheese dairy. Woo them with gifts, discover their unique stories, and after marriage, your chosen one will move in with you—maybe even start a family!

Build your cheese empire! Hire spirit employees, manage resources, and become the best cheese seller in the entire North!

Expand the museum’s collection. Gather ancient artifacts and minerals to uncover the secrets of Little Brick Town!

Cook and craft. Master hundreds of recipes—from hearty meals that grant temporary buffs to practical items like vats, shelves, and even high-tech cheese-making machines.

Customize your cheese dairy. Decorate your home and farm however you like—creativity knows no bounds!

Enjoy an atmospheric soundtrack (3+ hours of original music).

short_description: Say Cheese is a farmer simulator with roguelike elements, in which Sonya will not only develop her own cheese factory, but also find out the reason why everyone in the city has nightmares at night.
